rawContent:
I'm RTing & listening, but I don't have any words to add, & I don't want to cause more harm by centering myself.

I'm sorry I'm not better at this; I want to be better, so I'm going to stay quietish, checking myself, till I am. #BlackLivesMatter #everyday #AbolishPolice

Text: What’s happening in the US has always been happening, and it’s always been evil. Police target & murder Black people in every city, every day, & our built-this-broken whiteness-soaked justice system protects cops 1/
#BlackLivesMatter #AbolishThePolice https://t.co/FrWb4yOLr0

...but there can’t be justice without confronting the evils of whiteness. 
No justice, no peace. 

My family stands with the protesters on the streets and in their homes, today and always.
3/
#BlackLivesMatter #AbolishThePolice

@CobbSchools Now would be an excellent time to encourage students, teachers, and staff to stand with protesters in solidarity with #BlackLivesMatter and commit to practicing and teaching anti-racism in all our schools. What use is your education agenda when you stay silent?
